title: 36 Hours in Reykjavik, Iceland
abstract: The country’s financial collapse — a sharp devaluation of the currency — hasn’t dampened the capital city’s vibrant spirit.

title: 36 Hours in Washington, D.C.
abstract: Infused with a new crowd of idealistic young political worker bees, the U.S. capital is suddenly hip again.

title: 36 Hours in Carmel-by-the-Sea
abstract: With its storybook English cottages, this small town in Northern California resembles a Disneyland version of Europe.

title: 36 Hours in Vail, Colo.
abstract: The nation’s largest ski resort does not have the charm of Telluride. Nor does it exude the glitz of Aspen. But one thing it does have is great snow.
